title: SILLAR ROUTE & CULEBRILLAS
description: Explore the Sillar Route and discover how white volcanic stone shapes Arequipa's architecture. End with a bath in the Culebrillas hot springs.
shortItinerary: Visit to sillar quarries and artisan workshops

itinerary.title: Sillar Route & Culebrillas
itinerary.description: Tour through the quarries where sillar is extracted, sculptor workshops, Culebrillas Canyon with cave paintings, and final bath in hot springs.

includes: Towels and locker at hot springs
recommendations: Wear comfortable clothes and closed shoes
Bring swimsuit and change of clothes
